gates.name: environment_identity
gates.requirement: OS, CPU affinity, power mode, interpreter, dependencies, process count, and thread count match the frozen environment

gates.name: accepted_output_equivalence
gates.requirement: accepted scientific fields and their semantic fingerprints are exactly equal or within a separately frozen subject tolerance across M0, M3, and M6

gates.name: production_trajectory_equivalence
gates.requirement: accepted increment sequence, production residual and tangent counts, nonlinear iteration counts, selected steps, commits, and solver reasons are identical across modes

gates.name: audit_work_separation
gates.requirement: additional replay and validation evaluations are labeled audit-only, counted separately, and remain included in total timing

gates.name: finite_and_schema
gates.requirement: all metrics are finite, nonnegative where applicable, and conform to the frozen output schema

gates.name: fresh_process_repetition
gates.requirement: two warm-ups and ten timed repetitions are separate single-process single-thread executions with no within-process repetition loop

invalid_cell_rule: Failure of any gate invalidates timing interpretation for the entire subject-workload triplet; raw runs remain preserved.
